accreditation_and_safety.campus_security: Closed campus during school hours; doors locked; tours/visits by appointment only; official photo ID required at check-in; surveillance across classrooms, common areas, parking lot, and playground.
accreditation_and_safety.age_and_grade_range: Kindergarten to 5th grade (ages 5–11) / Pre-K4 to 5th grade (ages 4–11 depending on program)

programs_and_plans.name: Core Instruction (AM)
programs_and_plans.summary: Four hours of structured bilingual (English–Spanish) academics covering literacy, math, inquiry-based learning, and daily focus/self-management skills.

programs_and_plans.name: Learning Beyond the Core (PM)
programs_and_plans.summary: Three hours of hands-on, project-based afternoon enrichment including art, science, movement, creative exploration, and peer community. Available as an extension or standalone for homeschool families.

programs_and_plans.name: Full Day Experience
programs_and_plans.summary: Combines morning Core Instruction (AM) and afternoon Learning Beyond the Core (PM) for a complete bilingual school day.

programs_and_plans.name: Exploration Fridays & STEM Lab
programs_and_plans.summary: Full-day hands-on inquiry featuring STEM challenges, bilingual Story Lab, and discovery activities. Available standalone or added to a Mon–Thu schedule.

programs_and_plans.name: Summer Camps
programs_and_plans.summary: Bilingual English–Spanish immersion camps (e.g., Medieval Times themes) designed to prevent summer learning loss through literacy, storytelling, art, play, and self-management. Reported weekly tuition example: $450/week + $50 non-refundable registration fee.

programs_and_plans.name: Homeschool / Modular Hybrid Model
programs_and_plans.schedule: Customizable (AM only, PM only, Fridays only, or combinations)
programs_and_plans.summary: No minimum daily attendance required; includes take-home learning materials, trimester calendar, and parent partnership while families handle remaining homeschooling.

faqs.q: Does my child have to attend every day?
faqs.a: No. iBis Learning uses a modular schedule with no minimum daily commitment. Families can enroll for Mornings only (Mon–Thu, 8:30 AM–12:30 PM), Afternoons only (Mon–Thu, 12:30 PM–3:30 PM), Fridays only (8:30 AM–3:30 PM), Full Days (Mon–Thu, 8:30 AM–3:30 PM), or custom combinations.

faqs.q: What grades and ages does iBis Learning serve?
faqs.a: iBis Learning serves students from Pre-K4 through 5th grade (ages 4–11 depending on the program; Core Instruction AM and Summer Camp serve Kindergarten–5th grade, ages 5–11) in small classes capped at 12 students.

faqs.q: How does the bilingual English–Spanish instruction work?
faqs.a: Children learn in both English and Spanish through dedicated, focused language blocks rather than rapid switching, building genuine biliteracy alongside daily focus and self-management skills. Homeschool students also receive take-home materials to reinforce both languages at home.

faqs.q: Is iBis Learning accredited, and can we use Texas Education Savings Accounts (ESA / TEFA)?
faqs.a: iBis Learning is a Candidate for Accreditation with the Middle States Association (MSA), led by TEA-certified bilingual founder Ligia 'GiGi' Vasquez, and is pursuing TEA approval as an Education Savings Account (TEFA/ESA) provider. Contact the team directly for the latest TEFA status and founding family scholarship options.

faqs.q: How do we enroll, and do we need to tour first?
faqs.a: Enrollment is open year-round in three steps: (1) reach out for program and tuition details, (2) schedule an in-person family tour by appointment (valid photo ID required at check-in), and (3) complete enrollment forms in the online Guest Area. Submitting an application via Enroll Now requires a $150 non-refundable application fee and does not guarantee placement.
